This [[Technologies|technology tree]] deals with farming and the manipulation of nature. This involves growing crops, gathering food, fruit trees, beekeeping, wine and beer production as well as fishing.

==Farming==
This branch is unlocked upon talking to [[Horadric]] about the [[kitchen garden]] after reading the sign at the blueprint table there. For more information on growing crops see [[farming]].
